versions.description_html:
Learn the difference between Azure Reservations and Savings Plans. Discover how to cut cloud costs, choose the right term, and avoid wasted spending.

Normally the cloud bills you after the fact. You start a virtual machine, it runs for a month, and the bill arrives based on what you used.In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Pay Before You Use It
  • Azure Reservations, Simply Explained
  • Azure Savings Plans, the Looser Option
  • What Each One Actually Covers
  • Which One Fits
  • One Year or Three
  • Where Your Discount Applies
  • The Only Math That Matters
  • The Mistakes That Waste Money
  • A Quick Recap and One Question
Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
